purpose: Test 6 (runs after every phase from P2 on, against every response the checks see).

invariants.rule: No API response body contains a free-text field produced by a model. Allowed: ids, enums, numbers, booleans, and text copied from approved static content.
invariants.how: Schema allow-list per endpoint; any extra string field fails. Run on classify, grade, referral, journey and home responses.

invariants.rule: No page or API response shows a journey, card or sentence that lacks the project team's approval matching the current text hash.
invariants.how: Crawl /[locale]/home, the library and every /[locale]/j/[id]; compare shown ids and hashes with review_decisions.

invariants.rule: A topic marked needs_sharii is never shown unless a real sharia reviewer approved it.
invariants.how: Seed one needs_sharii draft with team approval only; assert it is absent everywhere; add sharia approval; assert it appears without the badge.

invariants.rule: Editing an approved sentence returns it (and its journey) to unapproved.
invariants.how: Approve, edit one sentence, assert status unapproved and the journey disappears from production pages.

invariants.rule: Team-approved ordinary journeys show the badge 'approved by the project team, awaiting sharia review'; sharia approval removes it.
invariants.how: Rendered HTML check on the journey page.

note: Assertions only; the scripts are written on Oct 4 inside the phases that create these endpoints.
